correctness.rationale: A prescribed injective partial mapping gives disjoint directed paths and closed cycles. Each prescribed edge reduces the number of path components by one, so in a three-position window there are n-3 paths, including isolated vertices. The remaining arrows match tails to heads uniformly; the completed cycle count has mean H_(n-3) plus the forced closed-cycle count, with H_0=0. There are (n)_3/6 equiprobable triples per pattern. A fixed point at x of rank r contributes binom(x-1,r-1) binom(n-x,3-r); a transposition fixes two ranks and leaves the last rank in the appropriate interval; 231 and 312 each contribute one three-cycle. Adding these counts with multiplicity and subtracting (n)_3(H_n-H_(n-3))=3n²-6n+2 after normalization yields the six claimed affine formulas. The constant nonzero 123 row and nonconstant 132 row give rank two when there are at least two positions; the single column at n=3 is nonzero. The two pooled pairs each have numerator -4. Independent disjoint-set counting of cycles and comparison-based ranks reproduced all 126 cells for n=3..8 with integer arithmetic.
residual_risks: The finite replay corroborates the symbolic proof; it is not a proof for unbounded n by itself.

evidence: Joint cycle type with peak or descent statistics does not by itself split 132/231 or 213/312. The earlier fixed-injection mean and local cycle contribution formulas preserve the entire three-image rank pattern at a chosen position.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The direct cover is the local conditional calculation in the earlier proof, not the higher-level peak/descent joint laws.

evidence: At fixed t the earlier proof gives transposition totals in lexicographic pattern order (0,t,n-t-1,n-t-2,t-1,n-2) by summing at most three already listed terms; three-cycle totals are (0,0,0,1,1,0); its binomial fixed-point formula gives the three summands per row. The harmonic normalization is the same as in its covariance step, now with one window instead of n-2.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Stopping before the earlier aggregation and expanding the supplied formulas gives the complete positional table with no new combinatorial count. The position-affine table directly yields the claimed rank and pooled corollaries.

evidence: 5a13f0bb8311 has a fixed-t image-conditioned mean; 600c70231432 gives the table and rank as a conditional-mean shift, which equals six times the covariance because the event probability is 1/6. Parviainen uses cycle notation and Fu–Li marks one-line peak orientations without cycle count.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Conditional means and covariances here are exactly interchangeable. Patterns within standard cycle notation are a different event. The decisive earlier overlap is in the fixed-t proof, not in the choice of notation.

originality.rationale: The earlier indexed Resultary finding 5a13f0bb8311 is an aggregate theorem in its headline, but its actual proof supplies the requisite stronger position-specific ingredients. It explicitly gives the conditional cycle mean for every fixed image triple at t, the fixed-point contribution by position and rank, every nonzero two-cycle contribution already as a function of t for each pair of positions and pattern, and the two exact three-cycle assignments. Keep t fixed instead of summing over it: the normalized local covariance is six times the sum of those supplied counts minus 3n²-6n+2. For example, 132 has the supplied fixed-point sum W1(t)+W3(t+1)+W2(t+2), transposition count t and no three-cycle; expansion gives 9n-14-12t. The same direct substitution works in all six cells and the rank assertion is elementary from those entries. This is coverage by the prior equations and case evaluation, not an inference from the aggregate vector alone or from title similarity. Two other indexed findings explicitly give the same positional table, but no priority or independent authorship is inferred from their catalogue dates.
residual_risks: The complete original Gessel–Reutenauer text was not obtained.
The relation among equivalent later records and the frozen work is not established; the FAIL is based on the older pre-aggregation formulas, not on inferred provenance.
